BIGapp provides a graphical interface for common genomic analyses, including workflows for population structure, association analysis, genomic prediction, and related tasks.

{{< tool-tags >}}
:::
<img class="software-logo" src="../assets/software/logos/software-bigapp.png" alt="BIGapp logo">
:::

## Start here

To run BIGapp on your own computer, install [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) (version 4.4.0 or later), then install BIGapp and its dependencies from an R console:

```r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")
install.packages("remotes")

BiocManager::install("Breeding-Insight/BIGapp", dependencies = TRUE)
```

Start the app; it opens in your default web browser:

```r
BIGapp::run_app()
```

## Good fit for

- Users who prefer an interactive graphical workflow
- Teaching genomic analysis concepts without requiring command-line expertise
- Analyses supported by the BIGr/BIGapp ecosystem
